data.title: 'Illuminating Discoveries' Exhibition Offers AlUla Visitors Insight into Ancient Civilizations
data.content:
AlUla, November 20, 2026, SPA -- The "Illuminating Discoveries" exhibition offers visitors an opportunity to explore the history and civilizations of the ancient city of Dadan through more than 100 artifacts discovered at the archaeological sites of Dadan and Umm Daraj. These artifacts provide insights into daily life, crafts, trade, and beliefs in the region.
    The permanent exhibition, held at the Dadan archaeological site, highlights the city's significance as a political and commercial center along the Incense Route during the first millennium BCE and its connections to trade networks linking the Arabian Peninsula with ancient civilizations.
    The exhibits include tools, handicrafts, inscriptions, and statues, some dating from 400 to 50 BCE, along with evidence of metalwork and textile production.
    Inscriptions and rock art reveal aspects of life in Dadan, with field surveys documenting depictions of horsemen carrying spears. The exhibition also features a fragment of sandstone bearing a Minaean inscription.
    These findings are linked to nearby Jabal Ikmah, which contains approximately 300 inscriptions, most dating to the Dadanite and Lihyanite periods. The site is listed on UNESCO's Memory of the World Register.
    The exhibition is organized into five themes: crafts and daily life, exchange and trade, beliefs, rock inscriptions, and the Umm Daraj site. It also features artifacts displayed to the public for the first time.
    The exhibition was organized through cooperation between the Royal Commission for AlUla (RCU), the French National Centre for Scientific Research (CNRS), and the French Agency for AlUla Development (AFALULA), as part of the Saudi-French archaeological missions at the site.
    Visitors of all ages can explore the exhibition during this period as part of the Dadan and Jabal Ikmah Tour, with specialized guides providing explanations of the exhibits and the history of Dadan.
    -- SPA
